Since one of the main appeals of VOAT is that it allows anything within legal/reasonable bounds to be shared and discussed it makes it hard for the casual user such as myself to enjoy, and discuss content on the site when much of it is getting bloated with literally racist, bigoted, volatile posts, comments and discussions.

So here is my proposal. Rather than necessarily blocking them, shadow banning them, or otherwise removing them, we create a "Volatile" report option. This can do a few things.

  • First: This would allow mods to address posts with only a handful of reports. So if something isn't totally crazy it won't be altered immediately.

  • Second: If any single comment or post hits a certain threshold it will be given a volatile tag and be put at the bottom of any discussion or page by default. Still 100% viewable, just out of the way of more neutral, friendly discussion. If mods think something is being brigaded they can remove the volatile tag at will. Or choose a subverse setting that makes it so there is no automation, that all content reported as volatile must be reviewed first.

  • Third: Just like the 'Controversial' filter if people want to see the volatile content first and foremost they can. Or even make an option for users to turn off the automatic sorting from their personal experience.

I believe this would be a vast improvement on what we have right now as I just perused the site for the first time in weeks and it is atrocious with most 'hot' content and/or their comments.
